title: Ophiolite contracts registry
description: Every schema, profile and document Ophiolite publishes under contracts/, with its id, version, lifecycle and registry-relative path. The directory references nothing outside itself.

lifecycles.meaning: Served and tested; the deployment may replace it with a new id suffix inside the program without a transition release.
Qualification criteria are written in the entry (qualified_by); only additive 1.x changes; deprecation needs a transition release with an announced cutoff.
Still served until the cutoff date in the entry; consumers move to the entry named in replaced_by.

schemas.title: ContractsRegistry
schemas.description: The registry index: every schema, profile and document with its id, version, lifecycle and path.

schemas.title: ContractProfile
schemas.description: A profile document: display name, description, role, media types, representation rules and interpretation identity.

schemas.title: ScientificAsset
schemas.description: The scientific asset descriptor (envelope): exact identity, origin, representations, retention, provenance and authorization.

schemas.title: ApplicationCurve
schemas.description: A normalized LAS curve as the source stored it, with its source reference, digest and interpretation identity.

schemas.title: ScientificContext
schemas.description: Observed facts about a normalized curve: units and their status, sample and missing counts, axis order.

schemas.title: AssetSummary
schemas.description: A discovery summary: identity, origin, profile, curve names and the operations allowed to the caller.

schemas.title: TypedContext
schemas.description: Observed and declared context of a typed asset (tops, trajectory, grid, triangulated surface, point set, fault sticks, seismic volume, wavelet, rock model section, seismic section, time-depth table) with its fidelity report.

schemas.title: WellTops
schemas.description: Normalized well tops in source order with their source reference, digest, context and reader identity.

schemas.title: Trajectory
schemas.description: Normalized survey stations with their source reference, digest, context and reader identity.

schemas.title: GridSurface
schemas.description: A normalized regular-grid surface: every cell value in file order with its source reference, digest, context and reader identity.

schemas.title: TriangulatedSurface
schemas.description: A normalized triangulated surface: vertices, triangles and attributes in file order with source reference, digest, context and reader identity.

schemas.title: PointSet
schemas.description: A normalized point set: points and numeric attributes in file order with source reference, digest, context and reader identity.

schemas.title: PointSet2
schemas.description: A recipe-read point set: points in file order, number/text/category attributes with exact source labels, and the decisions that set its context.

schemas.title: ImportRecipe
schemas.description: An import recipe: columns, parsing, observation rules with precedence, declarations and the registered operations declare, select-column and mark-missing.

schemas.title: WellCurve
schemas.description: Structural shape of an ordered well curve exchange snapshot; cross-field rules stay in catalog.validate_snapshot.

schemas.title: ScalarMap
schemas.description: Structural shape of a regular scalar map exchange snapshot; cross-field rules stay in catalog.validate_snapshot.

schemas.title: PortableBundleManifest
schemas.description: The portable bundle manifest: exact selected revisions with files, digests, served context, permitted lineage, omissions and losses (E18).

schemas.title: PortableBundleManifestV2
schemas.description: Portable bundle 2: exact selected revisions of well logs, well tops, trajectories, regular-grid surfaces, meshes, point sets, fault sticks, seismic slices, wavelets, rock model sections, seismic sections and time-depth tables with files, digests, served context, permitted lineage and relationships.

schemas.title: PolylineSet
schemas.description: Normalized fault sticks: sticks and points in file order with source reference, digest, context and reader identity.

schemas.title: WellLocationUpload
schemas.description: A normalized well location: one surface point in the CRS its file states, with source reference, digest, context and reader identity (E29).

schemas.title: WellLocation
schemas.description: A well's location as read: the stored point and CRS, the exact revision (and row) it came from and the association tying it to the well (E29).

schemas.title: Wavelet
schemas.description: A normalized wavelet: every sample in file order with the declared kind, frequencies, sample interval, first time and polarity, source reference, digest and reader identity (E53).

schemas.title: ModelSection
schemas.description: A normalized 2D rock model: rocks with P-wave velocity and density and a rock-index grid on declared vertical and horizontal axes, with source reference, digest and reader identity (E53).

schemas.title: SeismicSection
schemas.description: A normalized 2D seismic section: every sample, one row per vertical sample, on declared axes with origin and polarity, source reference, digest and reader identity (E53).

schemas.title: TimeDepth
schemas.description: A normalized time-depth table: depth and time pairs in file order, both strictly increasing, with the stated velocity column, the declared depth type, time kind, units and datum, source reference, digest and reader identity (E57).

schemas.title: SeismicVolume
schemas.description: A seismic volume description: grid, sample meaning, header decisions and per-inline chunk digests.

schemas.title: SeismicSlice
schemas.description: One inline, crossline or sample slice of a seismic volume at an exact revision, with exact samples and its declared scope.

schemas.title: RelationshipRegistry
schemas.description: The registered relationship predicates: class, joined kinds, cardinality, exact-revision binding, asserting party and required evidence (E20).

schemas.title: Entity
schemas.description: A well or wellbore with an external or explicitly provisional identity, its part-of link and identity history (E20).

schemas.title: EntityAssets
schemas.description: The exact revisions associated with an entity that the caller may read, with the evidence of each association (E20).

schemas.title: Lineage
schemas.description: One hop each way from an exact revision: parents, derivations and superseded revisions the caller may read (E20).

schemas.title: CheckRecord
schemas.description: One comparison of an output with a reference under stated rules and a tolerance: what was compared, the outcome and its differences, and who witnessed it (server, claimed or personal); a refusal names one field (E96).

schemas.title: DerivationRecord
schemas.description: How a version was made: kind, implementation, the registry words at execution time, parameters, release, inputs by slot and lineage commitment, outputs by role, and the digest over the making (E94).

schemas.title: Parameters
schemas.description: A calculation's request and what it resolved to, as canonical typed trees: sorted object entries, ordered arrays, numbers as shortest round-trip decimal text, NFC strings (E94).

schemas.title: TableTarget
schemas.description: What a table must hold to become one type of data: its fields, the choices that describe the whole table and, for a free table, the questions asked of each column (E86).

profiles.description: A LAS 2.0 text file of depth-indexed well log curves, kept byte for byte as the source stored it.
One curve from a LAS file exactly as the source stored it: original depth order and units, missing samples as null, with the reader identity that produced it.
A curve on strictly increasing measured depth in metres with an explicit well identity and depth datum; the native protobuf exchange form.
A regular row-major grid of numeric samples with explicit units, coordinate unit and CRS status; the native protobuf exchange form.
A single-band GeoTIFF kept as the source stored it; its nodata and CRS are source declarations.

profiles.display_name: Well locations from a SQL table
profiles.description: Well records read through a reviewed customer mapping from a SQL table; current values only.
A retained, exactly readable result of editing well records in a saved draft.
An approved OSDU record kind read exactly from an upstream OSDU service.
A well log stored as Parquet behind an approved OSDU record, read exactly from upstream.
An ExternalSnapshot supplied by a caller through the native protobuf API with caller-declared mapping.
A CSV of formation tops by name and measured depth, kept byte for byte as the uploader provided it.
A CSV of survey stations (measured depth, inclination, azimuth), kept byte for byte as the uploader provided it.
A regular grid of surface values in the ESRI ASCII grid format, kept byte for byte as the uploader provided it.
Tops in source order with names, measured depths and any provided vertical depths, the declared depth unit and basis, and the reader identity.
Survey stations in increasing measured depth with inclination and azimuth as provided (missing angles null), the declared azimuth reference and datum.
Every grid cell value in file order (first row north) with missing cells null, origin, cell size, registration and the declared CRS, units and vertical meaning.
A triangulated surface in the documented ophiolite-mesh text format (vertices, triangles, optional attributes), kept byte for byte.
A CSV of points (x, y, optional z and numeric attributes), kept byte for byte as the uploader provided it.
Every vertex (missing z null) and triangle in file order with attributes, extent and the declared CRS, units and vertical meaning.
Every point in file order (missing z null) with numeric attributes, extent and the declared CRS, units and vertical meaning.
A Petrel "Points with attributes" export with its README and CRS metadata, kept byte for byte and read through an import recipe (number, text and category attributes).
An OpendTect horizon ASCII export with x, y and z columns, kept byte for byte and read through an import recipe; inline/crossline exports are refused.
Every point in file order (missing z null) with number, text and category attributes, each field of context taken from a recorded decision.
How one source dialect is read: column roles and kinds, parsing, missing markers, how each field of context is observed and which observation wins, and only registered operations.
Fault sticks exported by OpendTect as FaultStickSet ASCII (x y z stick-index), kept byte for byte.
Every stick in first-appearance order with its points in file order and stick indices as written, with the declared CRS, units and vertical meaning.
A SEG-Y volume (revision 1 or 2, IBM or IEEE floating-point samples, big-endian, fixed-length traces on a full grid) kept byte for byte; slices are read one inline at a time.
The volume grid, sample meaning, every header decision and the digests of its per-inline chunks; samples are read as slices.
One well's surface point as a JSON object (x, y, the CRS it is stated in and the elevation reference), kept byte for byte as the uploader provided it.
One surface point with the CRS it is stated in and the elevation reference, exactly as the file states them; nothing is transformed.
A wavelet in the documented ophiolite-wavelet text format (kind, sample interval, first time, polarity and every sample), kept byte for byte.
Every sample in file order with the declared kind and frequencies, sample interval, first time and polarity.
A 2D rock model in the documented ophiolite-model-section text format (axes, rocks with P-wave velocity and density, a rock-index grid), kept byte for byte.
Every rock with its velocity and density and every grid cell as its rock index, with the declared vertical and horizontal axes.
A 2D seismic section in the documented ophiolite-seismic-section text format (axes, origin, polarity, one row per sample), kept byte for byte.
Every sample, one row per vertical sample and one value per trace, with the declared axes, origin and polarity.
A checkshot or time-depth table as CSV with the columns depth and time, optionally velocity, kept byte for byte.

Depth and time pairs of one wellbore in file order, both strictly increasing, with the velocity column as stated and the declared depth type, time kind, units and datum; nothing is interpolated or converted.
